channel.title: Gay Community News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Gay Community News (gcn.ie)

item.title: New US immigration rule could allow officers to revoke trans people's visas
item.description: A new rule, coming into force on April 10, 2026, could open the door for US immigration officers to revoke the visas of trans applicants.

item.title: Legendary LGBTQ+ pub The Black Cap set to re-open after 10 year closure
item.description: The Black Cap, one of London's most beloved LGBTQ+ venues, is set to reopen this weekend after a 10-year closure.

item.title: Gay wrestler Aaron Rourke makes history as first out WWE singles champion
item.description: Aaron Rourke has officially made wrestling history after he became the first openly gay WWE singles champion.

item.title: Portugal advances bills to roll back trans rights
item.description: Lawmakers in Portugal voted on three anti-trans bills aimed at rolling back legal gender recognition and restricting access to healthcare.

item.title: Watch: Two rival boxers battle it out in new Irish sapphic film
item.description: The trailer for Catfight, a brand new sapphic Irish film, has just dropped and it's all about queer intimacy, desire and gorgeous boxers.

item.title: Poland must recognise same-sex marriages from EU states following landmark ruling
item.description: Poland must now recognise same-sex marriages conducted in other European Union member states following the landmark ruling.

item.title: Graham Norton, Nicola Coughlan and Kate Butch amongst guests for first ever SNL UK
item.description: A host of familiar faces, including Graham Norton, Nicola Coughlan and Kate Butch were among the guest list for the first SNL UK.

item.title: Black trans activist and drag icon Shyyell Diamond Sanchez-McCray fatally shot
item.description: Tributes have been flooding in following the death of Shyyell Diamond Sanchez-McCray, an activist and drag performer.

item.title: United Nations vote against US proposal to redefine 'gender' at women’s rights commission
item.description: Member states at the United Nations’ 70th annual Commission on the Status of Women, have halted a proposal by the US to redefine “gender"

item.title: ACT UP holds powerful die-in protest against Trump administration
item.description: ACT UP, a global HIV activist group, recently marked their 39th year in operation with a die-in outside Palantir in New York City.
